name: RISEx
steps: Get an invite code. RISEx is in gated mainnet, and codes come from existing traders, the team or the waitlist referral leaderboard.
Go to rise.trade , click Trade Now and sign in with Google or an EVM wallet.
Enter the code, enable trading and switch to the RISE network.
Deposit USDC from your wallet or to a deposit address.
Trade. Your balance updates after each weekly drop on the points page .
what: RISEx pays 200,000 RISE Points a week in Season 1, which ends by Q2 2027 at the latest. How to get into the gated perps exchange, costs and risks.
behind: RISE is led by co-founder and CEO Sam Battenally; CTO Hai Nguyen previously founded MELD. A $4 million investment from Galaxy Ventures in June 2025 brought RISE's total funding to $8 million, according to its blog, and the docs also name Finality Capital, DACM and Vitalik Buterin as backers.
